plugins.name: go-linter-driven-development
plugins.description: Rules-as-data linter-driven development workflow for Go: 12 single-source rule files, thin directional skills (design, TDD implementation, refactoring, testing, review, documentation), and a hunter/skeptic/critic review architecture with parallel single-rule reviewers, an over-abstraction skeptic, and a comment critic enforcing the Comment Value Toolbox

plugins.name: linter-driven-development
plugins.description: Rules-as-data linter-driven development workflow for any language: the Go plugin's 12 rules, thin directional skills and hunter/skeptic/critic review, with the language detected from the repository at run time and its own linter run instead of a bundled one

plugins.name: python-linter-driven-development
plugins.description: Rules-as-data linter-driven development workflow for Python: the Go plugin's 12 rules, thin directional skills and hunter/skeptic/critic review, rendered with Python knowledge — ruff and mypy routing, pytest, dataclasses and Protocols, threads and asyncio, docstrings

plugins.name: ts-react-linter-driven-development
plugins.description: Linter-driven development workflow for TypeScript + React with 6 specialized skills: meta orchestrator, component design, testing, refactoring, review, and documentation
